subject: OWNER ORDER 2026-11-03 14:3xZ: apply it + OmniRoute across ALL models
body:
Owner's words, verbatim: "Apply it and fix the local 9B model and it should be all models actually for OmniRoute".

(1) APPLY IT — answers hand 2026-11-03-every-local-build-dies-before-an-edit-the-runtim. Apply the one-hunk fix from brain note bc642fe2 to signalgrid_agent_runtime.py (stop offering 'read' after two reads so the third turn must edit; accept new-file tasks at intake if that is in the same hunk), back up both files first, re-pin the runtime hash inside signalgrid_brain.py and the accounting pin over signalgrid_brain.py, and run one local build end to end on the 9B to prove an edit lands and reaches a PR. Then hand:clear that hand with the result and the PR number.

(2) FIX THE LOCAL 9B — whatever still stops signalgrid-local/qwen3.5:9b from completing a build after (1) is in scope; report the measured result (task, turns, edit made, exit).

(3) OMNIROUTE = ALL MODELS — the owner wants OmniRoute to route across every available model, not only the 9B: every local model Ollama/OmniRoute can serve plus the paid models when they have quota, with OmniRoute choosing the best available per task and falling back when credit or usage runs out (the standing rule). Register every installed local model in OmniRoute, set routing so a paid model at its limit falls through to the best local one, and point the Codex omniroute profile (and the brain's builder) at the OmniRoute router rather than a pinned 9B id. Keep Codex's default config untouched so the paid model returns after its 2026-11-04 01:36Z reset.

(4) The stopped Codex app session: the owner has now said to fix and run on the local models — resume it through the OmniRoute profile once (1)–(3) hold.

No vault or iCloud content into GitHub. Reply by mail or on the mailbox PR with measured output; the cloud reviews and lands any resulting Hub PR under DR-037.
